categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business is the research, development, production, and sales of polystyrene (PS) series products. The main product categories include high-impact polystyrene (HIPS) and general-purpose polystyrene (GPPS), which are used in electronics, appliances, toys, daily plastic products, packaging, building materials, and medical devices. The company also generates revenue from property leasing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary core technologies for polystyrene production, including a unique high-impact polystyrene (HIPS) production technology called 'nano-scale in-situ polymerization modification one-step method' (超细粉体原位聚合改性一步法). This technology replaces traditional two-step modification processes with an advanced one-step polymerization process, offering advantages in production efficiency, energy conservation, environmental protection, product performance, and cost reduction. The company uses bulk polymerization processes and has obtained 27 patents, including 7 invention patents and 20 utility model patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves diverse downstream industries including electronics and electrical appliances, toys, daily plastic products, plastic packaging, building materials, and medical devices. The company has a customer base consisting of both direct sales customers and trade distributors. Major customers include manufacturers in the home appliance, consumer electronics, and plastic products sectors. The company also serves international markets, with overseas business showing growth.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Shantou Bonded Zone, Guangdong Province, China. It operates primarily in South China, with significant market presence in the South China and East China regions. The company is expanding its overseas business, particularly in Southeast Asia and other international markets. The company benefits from its location in a major plastic industry cluster in South China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the chemical industry value chain. It purchases raw materials (primarily styrene) from upstream petrochemical suppliers and sells finished polystyrene products to downstream manufacturers in various industries. The company maintains relationships with major suppliers including China National Petroleum Corporation (Guangdong Petrochemical), Zhangzhou Gulei Petrochemical, and China Shell Petrochemical.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on developing high-end, environmentally-friendly polystyrene materials as part of the strategic emerging industries. R&D priorities include: (1) optimizing existing production processes and improving product performance; (2) developing specialized and customized products for specific customer needs; (3) exploring new technologies such as co-polymerization and new rubber applications; (4) developing new products like BOPS film and specialized dairy bottle materials; (5) advancing digital and intelligent manufacturing; (6) promoting green and low-carbon production. The company invests approximately 3.7% of revenue in R&D activities.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of polystyrene products to manufacturers and through sales via trade distributors. The company employs a daily self-pricing model and maintains a strict cash-before-delivery payment policy with all customers. In 2024, direct sales accounted for 46.31% of revenue and distributor sales accounted for 52.99%, with property leasing contributing 0.70%. The company also generates revenue from property leasing of its office building.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: According to Zhuochuang Information's 2024-2025 China PS Market Report, the company is the largest polystyrene producer in South China with an annual production capacity of 350,000 tons. The company competes with other domestic PS manufacturers and faces competition from international suppliers. The company differentiates itself through superior product quality, diverse product portfolio, strong brand recognition, and established customer relationships. The industry is characterized by increasing competition as new capacity comes online, but the company maintains competitive advantages through technology, scale, and market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of RMB 1.694 billion (up 6.13% year-over-year) and net profit of RMB 97.21 million (up 21.33% year-over-year). Total assets reached RMB 3.877 billion at year-end 2024. The company has demonstrated steady growth with improving profitability. The company maintains a strong balance sheet with shareholders' equity of RMB 2.963 billion. The company has been profitable since its IPO in January 2022 and continues to generate positive cash flows from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, environmentally-friendly polystyrene products with superior performance characteristics. Key value propositions include: (1) proprietary nano-scale in-situ polymerization technology enabling superior product performance; (2) diverse product portfolio with multiple grades and specifications meeting varied customer requirements; (3) strong brand recognition and customer loyalty built over decades; (4) reliable supply chain and responsive customer service; (5) commitment to environmental sustainability and green production; (6) continuous innovation and product development; (7) competitive pricing enabled by scale advantages and efficient production. The company positions itself as a premium supplier of high-performance polystyrene materials for demanding applications.
